flows.source:
def main():
    resp = http_get("http://127.0.0.1:20081/pets?status=available")
    pets = json.decode(resp["body"])
    print("available_pets:", len(pets))

    sleep(1)
    create = http_post("http://127.0.0.1:20081/pets", body=json.encode({"name": "flow-created", "status": "available"}))
    print("create_status:", create["status"])
    created = json.decode(create["body"])
    print("new_pet_id:", created["id"])

    final = http_get("http://127.0.0.1:20081/pets")
    print("total_pets:", len(json.decode(final["body"])))
    print("content_type:", resp.get("headers", {}).get("Content-Type"))

main()
